{{Quote|Hold it right there. Do not move!|The droid speaking to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>}}
This '''aqua droid''' was part of a detachment of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] under command of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and took part in the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]].

==Biography==
During the invasion of Kamino by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], this [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droid]] was part of a detachment of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] tasked with reassembleing assault craft for the attack on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] capital, [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], which would be dropped into the sea disguised as [[Starship/Legends|starship]] debris from a diversionary space attack. Meanwhile, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was in Tipoca City during the battle, was curious about the debris falling from the starships as he considered the space attack to be weak, and dived underwater in a [[Kamino submarine/Legends|Kamino submarine]] where he discovered the Separatist's plan. This droid was the first to notice Obi-Wan and alerted the other droids who then attacked his submarine.

==Behind the scenes==
This Aqua droid only appeared in the episode [[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]] and was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].
